stemMd: Which set of lengths can form a nondegenerate triangle?
explanationMd: The sum of the two shorter sides must exceed the longest. Only 4+6>9 satisfies the strict triangle inequality among the choices.

distractorRationale.b: The smaller sides sum exactly to the largest, giving a degenerate figure.
distractorRationale.a: The smaller sides sum to less than the largest.
